import json
d=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w57-20260930/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-f1a1.json'))
keys=d['payload']['ordered_revision_keys']
gc="同一机构 “Grand Council of Elvala” 在本工作集主游戏 elvala 回忆录各章（索引0/13/39/46/48/51/66/81）统一译作「最高议会」，而此条（Cults fay-willows）译作「大议会」，跨条专名不一致。"
iss={
6:"源文 “the Grand Council Chambers” 译作「大议会会议厅」。"+gc,
10:"末句源文 “For the orcs, for Garkul's legacy !” 被译为「为了部落，为了加库尔的遗产！」，把 orcs（兽人）换成了 Pride（部落）；同组 intro-orc-yeti（索引20）源文才是 “For the Pride”。此处应作「为了兽人」。",
18:"首段 “petitioned the Grand Council”“Agreeing to the request” 译作「大议会」。"+gc+" 另外，第4段 “that enchantress” 指 Alreiwen，此处译作「女附魔师」，而同系列索引37/49 对同一人物的 enchantress 一律译作「女巫」，跨条称谓不一致。",
52:"首句 “General Aranion Gaweil, leader of the Grand Council of Elvala” 与主游戏回忆录标题 “leader of the Grand Council of Elvala” 指同一职位，此处却译作「埃尔瓦拉大议会领袖」。"+gc,
80:"坦塔洛斯的决议句 “It's resolved that we have much to gain… it's resolved that we have or can obtain the means… it's resolved that it is what the voting public desires” 是议会的正式决议用语（兹决议/兹认定），译文「这决定了我们从这方案里获益良多，决定了我们有或能取得……，也决定了这是选民们想要的」误解为因果上的“这决定了”，语义错误；同文另一份拷贝（索引9）已正确译作「兹认定……」，两条不一致。",
}
v=[]
for i,k in enumerate(keys):
  if i in iss: v.append({"revision_key":k,"verdict":"ISSUE","observation":iss[i]})
  else: v.append({"revision_key":k,"verdict":"OK"})
out={"contract":"translation_contextual_v2","candidate_identity":d['candidate_identity'],"verdicts":v}
s=json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
open('/tmp/w57_out.json','w').write(s)
print(len(v), d['candidate_identity'])
EOF
